name: Netorare Shimai Nisshi ~Daisuki na Kare no Yuujin Kimo-o ni Netorare Ninshin~
original_name: 寝取られ姉妹日誌 ～大好きな彼の友人キモ男に寝取られ妊娠～
source:
A netorare (cuckoldry) romance story from the narrative POVs of the cuckoldee and each girl.

Three sisters (the cool eldest, the rich-wannabe middle girl and the clumsy and cute youngest) are each targeted by a guy's uncouth friend. Photographs are taken. Hearts change. Then when they get pregnant...! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE129307.html]DLsite English[/url]]
